title: I like it
body: Just wish it was open source, I’d pay full price at that point.

title: Missing Containers
body: So far I’m very happy with the app. It delivers most of what it promises. My only issue is that when I connect with a server that has 30 or 40 containers the app will typically only display 24 to 25 of these. It will list the correct number of online/offline containers. Also, there is no mechanism to prompt for private key password. In some cases I would prefer not to store it with the application and just be prompted for it when the application starts. These two issues are the only things preventing me from giving it 5 stars.
